purpose: Roughly half the posting's stack overlaps: React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL and a testing habit are there; GraphQL, Terraform, AWS, Jest and Cypress are not. Checks that a half-match reads as a half-match instead of collapsing to strong or weak.

mustMatch.why: GraphQL is the biggest real gap in the stack and has to be named.
The other real gap: the posting expects the candidate to read Terraform.

mustNotList.why: All are in the CV's skills section.
The posting asks for a testing habit 'whatever the framework'; the CV has Mocha, Supertest and Playwright. Jest and Cypress specifically may be listed as missing, testing as a practice may not.
